## Checklist

- [ ] Entry is in alphabetical order within its section
- [ ] Description starts with a lowercase letter and ends with a period
- [ ] Link goes to official docs or GitHub (not a blog post or mirror)
- [ ] No duplicate entry exists in the list
- [ ] The tool is actively maintained (last commit within 12 months, or widely stable)
- [ ] PR title follows the format: `Add: Name`, `Update: Name`, or `Remove: Name`
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
